activity-date.narrative: BOL 2 is the biggest network of HR organisations in Bolivia. CSH focus on strengthening the advocacy capacities of the CSO including rightholders for the defense and enforcement of all Human Rights including SRHR. Through BOL 2 different activities and coordinations, CSOs will be articulated at the national and regional level and will be enhance in its monitoring compliance with the recommendations of international human rights mechanisms and SRHR, for instance in the national cycle of UPR. BOL 2 is also pivotal in different advocacy actions to promote the adoption of recommendations and plans of implementation. RFSU has supported BOL 2 since 2018.
